task_note: PH2 only provides 3 labels (common nevus / atypical nevus / melanoma), not the 7-class HAM10000 taxonomy. Evaluation is restricted to the model's 'mel' and 'nv' output probabilities, renormalized to sum to 1 (p_mel / (p_mel + p_nv)), thresholded at 0.5. This is NOT a like-for-like comparison with the 76.4% in-distribution 7-class accuracy figure -- it isolates melanoma-vs-nevus discrimination ability under domain shift.
